items.question: Qual a taxa anual de mortalidade nas internacoes por COVID ou coronavirus?

items.question: Quais faixas etarias tiveram maior taxa de mortalidade em internacoes por COVID ou coronavirus, considerando apenas faixas com mais de 10000 internacoes?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 40 THEN '00-39' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40-49' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50-59' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60-69' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN '70-79' ELSE '80+' END AS faixa_etaria, CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 40 THEN 1 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 2 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 3 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN 4 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ordem, "MORTE" FROM internacoes WHERE "DIAG_PRINC" IN ('B342', 'B972') AND "IDADE" IS NOT NULL) SELECT faixa_etaria, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM base GROUP BY faixa_etaria, ordem HAVING COUNT(*) > 10000 ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC

items.question: Como a taxa de mortalidade por doencas respiratorias compara inverno e fora do inverno por ano?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'inverno' ELSE 'fora_inverno' END AS periodo, "MORTE" FROM internacoes WHERE "DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL) SELECT ano, periodo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM base GROUP BY ano, periodo ORDER BY ano, periodo

items.question: Quais sao os 3 CIDs com maior taxa de mortalidade em cada estado MA e RS, considerando CIDs com mais de 1000 internacoes?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf, c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE m."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY m."SG_UF", c."DESCRICAO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uf ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC, total_internacoes DESC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT uf, diagnostico, total_internacoes, total_mortes, taxa_mortalidade FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY uf, rn

items.question: Quais municipios do RS tem taxa de uso de UTI acima da media estadual, considerando apenas municipios com mais de 1000 internacoes?
items.sql: WITH rs AS (SELECT m."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_uti FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" = 'RS' GROUP BY m."NO_MUNICIPIO"), media AS (SELECT SUM(internacoes_uti) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_internacoes), 0) AS taxa_media_rs FROM rs) SELECT rs.municipio, rs.total_internacoes, rs.internacoes_uti, ROUND(rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS taxa_uti FROM rs, media WHERE rs.total_internacoes > 1000 AND rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0) > media.taxa_media_rs ORDER BY taxa_uti DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Qual a razao anual entre uso de UTI em pacientes com 65 anos ou mais e pacientes com menos de 65 anos?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN "IDADE" >= 65 THEN '65_mais' ELSE 'menor_65' END AS grupo_idade, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MARCA_UTI" <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_uti FROM internacoes WHERE "IDADE" IS NOT NULL AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, grupo_idade), taxas AS (SELECT ano, grupo_idade, internacoes_uti * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_internacoes, 0) AS taxa_uti FROM agg) SELECT ano, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = '65_mais' THEN taxa_uti END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = 'menor_65' THEN taxa_uti END), 0), 2) AS razao_uti_65_mais_vs_menor_65 FROM taxas GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

items.question: Quais diagnosticos tiveram maior custo total de UTI entre internacoes que resultaram em obito?

items.question: Quais diagnosticos apresentam maior diferenca de permanencia media entre criancas e adultos, considerando diagnosticos com pelo menos 1000 internacoes em cada grupo?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, CASE WHEN i."IDADE" < 18 THEN 'criancas' ELSE 'adultos' END AS grupo_idade, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."DIAS_PERM") AS media_dias FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."IDADE" IS NOT NULL AND i."DIAS_PERM" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."DESCRICAO", grupo_idade), piv AS (SELECT diagnostico, MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = 'criancas' THEN total_internacoes END) AS n_criancas, MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = 'adultos' THEN total_internacoes END) AS n_adultos, MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = 'criancas' THEN media_dias END) AS media_criancas, MAX(CASE WHEN grupo_idade = 'adultos' THEN media_dias END) AS media_adultos FROM agg GROUP BY diagnostico) SELECT diagnostico, n_criancas, n_adultos, ROUND(media_criancas, 2) AS media_criancas, ROUND(media_adultos, 2) AS media_adultos, ROUND(ABS(media_adultos - media_criancas), 2) AS diferenca_absoluta FROM piv WHERE n_criancas >= 1000 AND n_adultos >= 1000 ORDER BY diferenca_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Em qual combinacao de estado e ano MA/RS ocorreu a maior taxa de mortalidade em internacoes com UTI?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortes_uti, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_uti FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m."SG_UF", ano) SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_uti DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Como a taxa de mortalidade compara internacoes de urgencia e eletivas por faixa etaria?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN '<18' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 39 THEN '18-39' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN '40-59' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN '60-79' ELSE '80+' END AS faixa_etaria, CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN 1 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 39 THEN 2 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3 WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS ordem, CASE WHEN "CAR_INT" = 1 THEN 'eletiva' WHEN "CAR_INT" = 2 THEN 'urgencia' ELSE 'outros' END AS carater, "MORTE" FROM internacoes WHERE "IDADE" IS NOT NULL AND "CAR_INT" IN (1, 2)) SELECT faixa_etaria, carater, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM base GROUP BY faixa_etaria, ordem, carater ORDER BY ordem, carater

items.question: Quais hospitais com mais de 5000 internacoes tem custo medio e taxa de mortalidade acima da media geral?
items.sql: WITH por_hospital AS (SELECT i."CNES", COALESCE(h."NO_HOSPITAL", 'Sem nome cadastrado') AS hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i."CNES", h."NO_HOSPITAL" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000), medias AS (SELECT AVG("VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio_geral, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade_geral FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL) SELECT p."CNES", p.hospital, p.total_internacoes, ROUND(p.custo_medio, 2) AS custo_medio, ROUND(p.taxa_mortalidade, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM por_hospital p, medias m WHERE p.custo_medio > m.custo_medio_geral AND p.taxa_mortalidade > m.taxa_mortalidade_geral ORDER BY p.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Qual a media movel de 3 anos da taxa de mortalidade no RS?
items.sql: WITH anual AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano), taxas AS (SELECT ano, total_internacoes, total_mortes, total_mortes * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_internacoes, 0) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM anual) SELECT ano, ROUND(AVG(taxa_mortalidade) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS media_movel_3_anos_taxa_mortalidade FROM taxas ORDER BY ano

items.sql: WITH geral AS (SELECT AVG("VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio_geral FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), por_capitulo AS (SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO") SELECT p.capitulo_cid, p.total_internacoes, ROUND(p.custo_medio, 2) AS custo_medio FROM por_capitulo p, geral g WHERE p.total_internacoes > 100000 AND p.custo_medio > g.custo_medio_geral ORDER BY p.custo_medio DESC

items.question: Quais diagnosticos tiveram maior crescimento percentual de internacoes do periodo 2015-2019 para 2020-2023?
items.sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_2015_2019 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2015 AND 2019 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_2020_2023 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, p1.total_2015_2019, p2.total_2020_2023, ROUND((p2.total_2020_2023 - p1.total_2015_2019) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p1.total_2015_2019, 0), 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1.cid = p2.cid JOIN cid c ON p1.cid = c."CID" WHERE p1.total_2015_2019 >= 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_percentual DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Quais diagnosticos tiveram maior aumento na taxa de mortalidade entre 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
items.sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n1, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n2, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, n1 AS internacoes_2008_2012, n2 AS internacoes_2019_2023, ROUND(m1 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n1, 0), 2) AS taxa_2008_2012, ROUND(m2 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n2, 0), 2) AS taxa_2019_2023, ROUND((m2 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n2, 0)) - (m1 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n1, 0)), 2) AS aumento_pontos_percentuais FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1.cid = p2.cid JOIN cid c ON p1.cid = c."CID" WHERE n1 >= 1000 AND n2 >= 1000 ORDER BY aumento_pontos_percentuais DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Quais sao os 5 hospitais por estado MA e RS com maior taxa de mortalidade em internacoes com UTI, considerando mais de 500 internacoes em UTI?

items.question: Quais municipios tiveram maior taxa de internacao por mil habitantes em 2021?

items.question: Como a taxa de internacao por mil habitantes em 2021 varia por quintil de PIB per capita?
items.sql: WITH mun AS (SELECT s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA", s."QT_POPULACAO", NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA") AS quintil_pib FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021 AND s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA" IS NOT NULL AND s."QT_POPULACAO" > 0), adm AS (SELECT "MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES") SELECT quintil_pib, COUNT(*) AS municipios, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes, SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO") AS populacao, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO"), 0), 2) AS internacoes_por_mil FROM mun LEFT JOIN adm ON mun."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = adm.municipio_codigo GROUP BY quintil_pib ORDER BY quintil_pib

items.question: Como a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar em 2021 varia por quintil de leitos SUS por mil habitantes?

items.question: Qual a taxa de mortalidade por sexo e faixa etaria nas internacoes por COVID ou coronavirus?

items.question: Quantas internacoes ocorreram com estado de residencia diferente do estado do hospital por ano?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, mr."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios mr ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mr."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND regexp_full_match(mr."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND regexp_full_match(mh."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$')) SELECT ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_estado_diferente FROM base WHERE uf_residencia <> uf_hospital GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

items.question: Quais pares de estado de residencia e estado do hospital tiveram maior volume de internacoes interestaduais?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT mr."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios mr ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mr."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE regexp_full_match(mr."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND regexp_full_match(mh."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$')) SELECT uf_residencia, uf_hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM base WHERE uf_residencia <> uf_hospital GROUP BY uf_residencia, uf_hospital ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Qual o custo medio por dia de internacao por especialidade e desfecho de morte?
items.sql: SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT" / NULLIF(i."DIAS_PERM", 0)), 2) AS custo_medio_por_dia FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL AND i."DIAS_PERM" > 0 GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", desfecho HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY custo_medio_por_dia DESC

items.question: Qual percentual de internacoes possui diagnostico secundario preenchido por ano e por desfecho?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL AND "DIAG_SECUN" <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS com_diag_secundario FROM internacoes WHERE "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, desfecho) SELECT ano, desfecho, total_internacoes, com_diag_secundario, ROUND(com_diag_secundario * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS percentual_com_diag_secundario FROM agg ORDER BY ano, desfecho

items.question: Quantos registros com idade zero parecem inconsistentes com data de nascimento e data de internacao por ano?
items.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS idade_zero_inconsistente FROM internacoes WHERE "IDADE" = 0 AND "NASC" IS NOT NULL AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', "NASC", "DT_INTER") >= 365 GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

items.question: Quais codigos de municipio de residencia sem correspondencia aparecem com maior volume de internacoes?
items.sql: SELECT i."MUNIC_RES" AS codigo_municipio_residencia, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."MUNIC_RES" IS NOT NULL AND m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" IS NULL GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Quais capitulos CID concentram mais internacoes de alto custo acima do percentil 99 do valor total?
items.sql: WITH limite AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT("VAL_TOT", 0.99) AS p99_valor FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), alto_custo AS (SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", i."VAL_TOT" FROM internacoes i, limite l WHERE i."VAL_TOT" > l.p99_valor) SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_alto_custo, ROUND(SUM(a."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_total_alto_custo FROM alto_custo a JOIN cid c ON a."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO" ORDER BY internacoes_alto_custo DESC LIMIT 10
